file_roles.evidence: parseDate early return extended to: text == null || text.isEmpty() || "D:".equals(text.trim()) so the 'D:   ' input never reaches charAt.

rationale: StringIndexOutOfBounds at DateConverter.parseDate:656 for input 'D:   '. The fix adds an input guard in the same function. It is an input guard rather than a fix of the charAt logic, so another reading is symptom-handling.
